title: Tackling Climate Change, Land Degradation and Fragility: Diagnosing Drivers of Climate and Environmental Fragility in Burundi’s Colline Landscapes: Towards a Multi-Sector Investment Plan to Scale up Climate Resilience
organization: World Bank and Government of Burundi
temporal_coverage: Historical climate series, mid-century projections, and spatial multi-risk assessment reported in 2022
methodology: Combines climate projections, land-degradation modeling and spatial multi-risk analysis of 2,616 collines.
limitations: Risk scores combine hazards, exposure, vulnerability, coping capacity and past conflict; they are not causal estimates. Rainfall projections vary.

title: Intended Nationally Determined Contribution (INDC) / Burundi
temporal_coverage: National vulnerability assessment and climate projections through 2050, as reported in 2015
methodology: Summarizes prior national communications, an ACCES soil-and-water vulnerability analysis, and general circulation model projections.
limitations: 2015 assessment using earlier studies; the cited projection passage does not name a scenario. Adaptation measures describe plans, not evaluated results.

title: Burundi Colline Climate Resilience Project (P180864): Appraisal Environmental and Social Review Summary
temporal_coverage: Appraisal-stage project context and proposed activities, 2024
methodology: World Bank appraisal summarizes cited colline climate-risk mapping, targeting and proposed activities.
limitations: Activities are proposed; cited risk analyses are summarized, not replicated.

title: Climate Change, Internal Mobility, and Conflict Dynamics: Country Brief - Burundi
temporal_coverage: Survey interviews May-July 2025; displacement experiences within the previous five years
methodology: Original country brief analyzing 1,027 in-person 4Mi surveys with internally displaced people, collected in Bujumbura city, Cibitoke and Makamba city.
limitations: Purposive sample focused on recent climate-linked movement and active mobility; results are illustrative, not representative. Cover date is April 2026, while the suggested citation inside the report says 2025.

title: Burundi country strategic plan (2024-2027)
temporal_coverage: Country strategic plan period 2024-2027; revision approved June 2026
methodology: WFP country strategic plan page describing climate and food-security context, planned outcomes and government capacity support.
limitations: The page states commitments and intended outcomes; it does not evaluate whether planned support has been delivered or caused results.
